systems.owner: Ministry of Education (Basic Education Principal Secretary)
systems.tiers: first rolled out January 2026; over 8,000 secondary schools enrolled by 6 June 2026, no total and no primary figure given; intended for primary, junior and senior schools, public and private, TVETs, universities and agencies (KNEC, KICD, SEPU, HELB)

note: The document says schools must register on KEMIS, a single database through which third-term capitation is to be paid (directive of 6 June 2026), and does not say that schools enter learner records in it, so KEMIS is left unclassified here and no fact is taken; the rollout date and the 8,000 secondary schools are in the systems entry.
